WITH latest AS (SELECT DC_ID, MATERIAL_ID, MAX(SNAPSHOT_DT) dt FROM dbo.DC_INV GROUP BY DC_ID, MATERIAL_ID),
inv AS (SELECT i.* FROM dbo.DC_INV i JOIN latest l ON l.DC_ID=i.DC_ID AND l.MATERIAL_ID=i.MATERIAL_ID AND l.dt=i.SNAPSHOT_DT),
dem AS (SELECT DC_ID, MATERIAL_ID, SUM(UNITS)/13.0 wk_avg FROM dbo.WHSLR_SHIP WHERE SHIP_DT > DATEADD(week,-13,'2026-09-30') GROUP BY DC_ID, MATERIAL_ID)
SELECT inv.DC_ID, inv.MATERIAL_ID, inv.SNAPSHOT_DT, inv.ON_HAND_UNITS, inv.SAFETY_STOCK_UNITS, dem.wk_avg, CAST(inv.ON_HAND_UNITS/NULLIF(dem.wk_avg,0) AS decimal(10,1)) wks_cover
FROM inv LEFT JOIN dem ON dem.DC_ID=inv.DC_ID AND dem.MATERIAL_ID=inv.MATERIAL_ID
WHERE inv.MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002','FG-1003','FG-3001','FG-3002','FG-3003','FG-3004','FG-3005','FG-3006','FG-3007','FG-3008','FG-3009','FG-3010','FG-3011')
ORDER BY inv.MATERIAL_ID, inv.DC_ID

SELECT DC_ID, MATERIAL_ID, SNAPSHOT_DT, ON_HAND_UNITS, SAFETY_STOCK_UNITS FROM dbo.DC_INV WHERE MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002') AND SNAPSHOT_DT>='2026-08-01' ORDER BY MATERIAL_ID, DC_ID, SNAPSHOT_DT

WITH wk AS (SELECT DISTINCT TOP 13 DATEADD(day, -((DATEPART(weekday,SHIP_DT)+5)%7), SHIP_DT) wk FROM dbo.WHSLR_SHIP ORDER BY 1 DESC)
SELECT s.DC_ID, s.WHSLR_ID, w.WHSLR_NM, w.REGION, s.MATERIAL_ID, SUM(s.UNITS) units_13wk, COUNT(*) n_ship, MIN(SHIP_DT) mn, MAX(SHIP_DT) mx
FROM dbo.WHSLR_SHIP s JOIN dbo.WHSLR w ON w.WHSLR_ID=s.WHSLR_ID
WHERE DATEADD(day, -((DATEPART(weekday,SHIP_DT)+5)%7), SHIP_DT) IN (SELECT wk FROM wk) AND s.MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002','FG-1003')
GROUP BY s.DC_ID, s.WHSLR_ID, w.WHSLR_NM, w.REGION, s.MATERIAL_ID ORDER BY s.MATERIAL_ID, s.DC_ID, s.WHSLR_ID
